headlines.text: On this day in 2022, The Elite vs. Death Triangle met in a Best of 7 Series, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 7.95 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
On this day in 2024, Daniel Garcia vs. Kazuchika Okada met in a Continental Classic League Match, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 7.36 ? a solid showing.
Back on this day in 2024, AEW welcomed Private Party & Mistico for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 5.60.

secondaries.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Bryan Danielson vs. Dax Harwood met for the very first time, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.95 ? a well-worked match.
It was 2022 when Samoa Joe vs. AR Fox went to battle over the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.23. It was the first title opportunity of AR Fox's career.
It was 2024 when Will Ospreay vs. Juice Robinson met in a Continental Classic League Match, opening the card on Collision, rated 6.65.
